chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Ḍurays al-Kunāsī, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

If a male slave confesses against himself once before the Imam that he stole, he is to have his hand cut off; and if a female slave confesses against herself before the Imam to theft, she is to have her hand cut off.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam as the judicial authority

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave confesses to theft before the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for theft when a slave or a female slave confesses before the Imam. It shows that a single self-confession before the Imam is sufficient for establishing the ruling in this case.
